description: Configures and personalizes the cookie consent banner for a site. Controls layout, theme colors, Google Consent Mode v2 integration, and tracker auto-blocking rules.

accent_color.description: Hex accent color for accept buttons (e.g. '#c8f135')

auto_block_trackers.description: Automatically withhold analytics and advertising scripts until consent is granted

enable_gcm_v2.description: Synchronize user choices directly with Google Consent Mode v2

name: configure_cookie_banner
